commands.title: All customers
commands.description: Show data of a customers account
commands.sql:
SELECT cu.customer_ID, cu.firstName, cu.lastName, cu.phoneNumber, cu.email, ad.country, ad.city, ad.district, ad.streetAddress
FROM customer cu
INNER JOIN [address] ad ON cu.address_ID = ad.address_ID
WHERE cu.customer_ID LIKE '%' + @customer_ID + '%'
	AND (
		cu.firstName LIKE '%' + @firstName + '%'
			AND cu.lastName LIKE '%' + @lastName + '%'
		)
	AND (
		ad.country LIKE '%' + @country + '%'
			AND ad.city LIKE '%' + @city + '%'
		)
ORDER BY cu.customer_ID ASC;

subSql.title: Update customer
subSql.sql:
UPDATE customer
SET firstName = @firstName,
	lastName = @lastName,
	phoneNumber = @phoneNumber,
	email = @email
WHERE customer_ID = @customer_ID;
UPDATE [address]
SET country = @country,
	city = @city,
	district = @district,
	streetAddress = @streetAddress
WHERE address_ID = (
	SELECT TOP 1 address_ID 
	FROM customer
	WHERE customer_ID = @customer_ID
)

subSql.title: Delete customer
subSql.sql:
DELETE FROM customer
WHERE customer_ID = @customer_ID

subSql.title: Reservations
subSql.sql:
SELECT re.reservation_ID, re.checkin, re.checkout, re.guests, dbo.FN_STATUS_DETAILS(re.[status]) AS [status], COALESCE(ho.hotelName, '') AS hotelName, COUNT(rr.roomNumber) AS reserved_rooms
FROM reservation re
LEFT OUTER JOIN room_reservation rr ON re.reservation_ID = rr.reservation_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN hotel ho ON rr.hotel_ID = ho.hotel_ID
WHERE customer_ID = @customer_ID
GROUP BY re.reservation_ID, re.checkin, re.checkout, re.guests, [status], ho.hotelName
ORDER BY re.checkin ASC

subSql.title: Cancel reservation
subSql.sql:
UPDATE reservation
SET [status] = 'C'
WHERE reservation_ID = @reservation_ID
	AND [status] = 'R'

commands.title: Search hotel
commands.description: Search for an available hotel by location, time period and number of guests
commands.sql:
SELECT ho.hotel_ID, ho.hotelName, ad.country, ad.city, ad.district, dbo.FN_FORMAT_PRICE(MIN(rc.price)) AS min_price
FROM roomCategory rc
INNER JOIN hotel ho ON rc.hotel_ID = ho.hotel_ID
INNER JOIN [address] ad ON ho.address_ID = ad.address_ID
WHERE ho.hotel_ID IN (
	SELECT hotel_ID 
	FROM room
	EXCEPT (
		SELECT rr.hotel_ID 
		FROM room_reservation rr
		INNER JOIN reservation re ON rr.reservation_ID = re.reservation_ID
		WHERE re.[status] IN ('R', 'P')
			AND re.checkin < @checkout
			AND re.checkout > @checkin
		)
	)
	AND ad.city LIKE '%' + @city + '%'
	AND ad.district LIKE '%' + @district + '%'
	AND rc.maxGuests >= @guests
GROUP BY ho.hotel_ID, ho.hotelName, ad.country, ad.city, ad.district
ORDER BY min_price ASC

subSql.title: Get available room categories
subSql.sql:
WITH RoomCategoryEquipment AS (
	SELECT rc.roomCategory_ID, STRING_AGG(eq.equipmentTitle, ', ') AS equipment
	FROM equipment eq
	INNER JOIN roomCategory_equipment rce ON rce.equipment_ID = eq.equipment_ID
	INNER JOIN roomCategory rc ON rc.roomCategory_ID = rce.roomCategory_ID
	GROUP BY rc.roomCategory_ID
)
SELECT rc.roomCategory_ID, rc.categoryTitle, rc.maxGuests, dbo.FN_FORMAT_PRICE(rc.price) price, CONCAT(rc.[size], 'm²') AS [size], rce.equipment, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.roomNumber) AS available_rooms
FROM roomCategory rc
LEFT OUTER JOIN RoomCategoryEquipment rce ON rce.roomCategory_ID = rc.roomCategory_ID
INNER JOIN room ro ON ro.roomCategory_ID = rc.roomCategory_ID
INNER JOIN room_reservation rr ON rr.roomNumber = rr.roomNumber
	AND rr.hotel_ID = ro.hotel_ID
INNER JOIN reservation re ON rr.reservation_ID = re.reservation_ID
WHERE re.reservation_ID NOT IN (
	SELECT reservation_ID
	FROM reservation
	WHERE [status] IN ('R', 'P')
		AND checkin  < @checkout
		AND checkout > @checkin
	)
	AND rc.hotel_ID = @hotel_ID
	AND rc.maxGuests >= @guests 
GROUP BY rc.roomCategory_ID, rc.categoryTitle, rc.maxGuests, CONCAT(rc.price, '€'), CONCAT(rc.[size], 'm²'), rce.equipment;

commands.title: All hotels
commands.sql:
SELECT ho.hotel_ID, ho.hotelName, ho.phoneNumber, ho.email, ad.country, ad.city, ad.district, ad.streetAddress

INNER JOIN [address] ad ON ho.address_ID = ad.address_ID

sql.title: Current Guests
sql.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cr.guests), 0) AS current_guests
FROM view_current_reservations cr
INNER JOIN room_reservation rr ON cr.reservation_ID = rr.reservation_ID
WHERE rr.hotel_ID = @hotel_ID

sql.title: Occupancy
sql.sql:
SELECT CONCAT(CAST(CAST(COUNT(cr.reservation_ID) AS FLOAT) / CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT ro.roomNumber) AS FLOAT) * 100 AS DECIMAL(5,2)), '%') AS occupancy
FROM room ro
LEFT JOIN room_reservation rr ON ro.hotel_ID = rr.hotel_ID AND ro.roomNumber = rr.roomNumber
LEFT JOIN view_current_reservations cr ON rr.reservation_ID = cr.reservation_ID
WHERE ro.hotel_ID = @hotel_ID

sql.title: Revenue (Current Year)
sql.sql:
SELECT dbo.FN_FORMAT_PRICE(SUM(iv.totalPrice)) AS current_year_revenue
FROM (
	SELECT DISTINCT reservation_ID FROM room_reservation WHERE hotel_ID = @hotel_ID
) rr
INNER JOIN invoice iv ON iv.reservation_ID = rr.reservation_ID
WHERE YEAR(iv.invoiceDate) = YEAR(GETDATE())

Rooms
subSql.sql:
SELECT ro.hotel_ID, ro.roomNumber, ro.[floor], rc.categoryTitle AS category,
	CASE
		WHEN re.checkin > GETDATE() OR re.checkout < GETDATE() THEN 'Free'
		WHEN re.reservation_ID IS NULL THEN 'Free'
		ELSE 'Occupied'
	END AS room_status
FROM room ro
INNER JOIN roomCategory rc ON ro.roomCategory_ID = rc.roomCategory_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN room_reservation rr ON ro.roomNumber = rr.roomNumber
	AND ro.hotel_ID = rr.hotel_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN reservation re ON rr.reservation_ID = re.reservation_ID
WHERE ro.hotel_ID = @hotel_ID;

Reservations
subSql.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT re.reservation_ID, re.checkin, re.checkout, re.guests, dbo.FN_STATUS_DETAILS(re.[status]) AS [status], dbo.FN_FULL_NAME(cu.firstName, cu.lastName) AS fullName, cu.phoneNumber, cu.email,
	CASE
		WHEN re.checkin > GETDATE() THEN 'Upcoming'
		WHEN re.checkout > GETDATE() THEN 'Current'
		WHEN re.checkout < GETDATE() THEN 'Former'
		ELSE 'Invalid'
	END AS reservation_category
FROM reservation re
INNER JOIN room_reservation rr ON rr.reservation_ID = re.reservation_ID
INNER JOIN customer cu ON cu.customer_ID = re.customer_ID
WHERE rr.hotel_ID = @hotel_ID
ORDER BY re.checkout DESC;

subSql.title: Print invoice
subSql.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT iv.reservation_ID AS invoice_ID,
	dbo.FN_FORMAT_PRICE(iv.totalPrice) AS totalPrice,
	iv.invoiceDate,
	dbo.FN_FULL_NAME(cu.firstName, cu.lastName) AS fullName,
	a1.streetAddress AS customerStreetAddress,
	a1.city AS customerCity,
	a1.country AS customerCountry,
	ho.hotelName,
	a2.streetAddress AS hotelStreetAddress,
	a2.city AS hotelCity,
	a2.country AS hotelCountry
FROM invoice iv
INNER JOIN reservation re ON iv.reservation_ID = re.reservation_ID
INNER JOIN customer cu ON re.customer_ID = cu.customer_ID
INNER JOIN [address] a1 ON iv.address_ID = a1.address_ID
INNER JOIN room_reservation rr ON re.reservation_ID = rr.reservation_ID
INNER JOIN hotel ho ON rr.hotel_ID = ho.hotel_ID
INNER JOIN [address] a2 ON ho.address_ID = a2.address_ID
WHERE iv.reservation_ID = @reservation_ID;

subSql.title: Statistics
subSql.sql:
WITH monthly AS (
	SELECT
		YEAR(iv.invoiceDate) AS [year],
		MONTH(iv.invoiceDate) AS [month],
		SUM(iv.totalPrice) AS monthly_revenue
	FROM invoice iv
	INNER JOIN room_reservation rr ON rr.reservation_ID = iv.reservation_ID
	WHERE rr.hotel_ID = @hotel_ID
	GROUP BY YEAR(iv.invoiceDate), MONTH(iv.invoiceDate)
)
SELECT
	[year], [month],
	monthly_revenue,
	SUM(monthly_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY [year] ORDER BY [month]) AS running_total_year,
	SUM(monthly_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY [year], [month]) AS running_total_all,
	LAG(monthly_revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY [year], [month]) AS prev_month_revenue,
	CAST(
		100.0 * (monthly_revenue - LAG(monthly_revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY [year], [month]))
		/ NULLIF(LAG(monthly_revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY [year], [month]), 0)
	 AS DECIMAL(5,2)) AS mom_growth_pct
FROM monthly
ORDER BY [year], [month]

commands.title: All contacts
commands.description: Get all contact information in the system
commands.sql:
SELECT cu.customer_ID AS ID, CONCAT(cu.firstName,' ',cu.lastName) AS [name], cu.phoneNumber AS phoneNumber, cu.email AS email, ad.country, ad.district, ad.streetAddress 
FROM customer cu 
INNER JOIN [address] ad ON cu.address_ID = ad.address_ID
UNION (
	SELECT ho.hotel_ID AS ID, ho.hotelName AS [name], ho.phoneNumber AS phoneNumber, ho.email AS email, ad.country, ad.district, ad.streetAddress 
	FROM hotel ho 
	INNER JOIN [address] ad ON ho.address_ID = ad.address_ID
)
ORDER BY [name] ASC;

commands.title: Ranking: hotel total earnings
commands.description: Ranking of all hotels by their total earnings
commands.sql:
SELECT ho.hotelName, SUM(iv.totalPrice) AS total_earnings,
	ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY SUM(iv.totalPrice) DESC) AS [row_number],
	DENSE_RANK() OVER(ORDER BY SUM(iv.totalPrice) DESC) AS hotel_earnings_dense_rank
FROM invoice iv
INNER JOIN reservation re ON re.reservation_ID = iv.reservation_ID
INNER JOIN room_reservation rr ON rr.reservation_ID = re.reservation_ID
INNER JOIN hotel ho ON ho.hotel_ID = rr.hotel_ID
GROUP BY ho.hotelName

commands.title: Never booked rooms
commands.description: Find rooms which where never booked

FROM room
